question: Which divine form must be meditated upon to proceed toward the promised attainment?
premises: One should meditate in the manner described
The object of meditation is Mātṛkā, supporter and mother of the world
inference: Meditation on Mātṛkā as world-supporter and world-mother is the required practice
plain_english: Thus, having meditated on Mātṛkā, the supporter and mother of the world.
